_doc: How a station's automation plays (openspec/changes/bridge-stations section 3; coop-drill design 3). 'automation' holds a seat nobody holds, at the lower competence of bridge-stations: helm reacts in 1.5 s, holds heading and speed and never flies evasive; tactical reacts in 2.0 s and never fires missiles. 'bot' is a bot client playing the seat like a decent player. reaction_s is how often it decides; rate_frac the share of the rate limit it turns at; standoff_m the range a hunting helm keeps; weave_deg and weave_period_s how it crosses the enemy's line of sight.
